source.name: Annual Remuneration Reports — Members of Council remuneration and expenses

source.note: Figures are the City Clerk's annual remuneration reports, shown as published. Annual reports are included for 2006–2009 and 2017–2025; the 2010–2016 reports are published only inside Council meeting records and are not yet included, and quarterly office-expense detail is also not yet included.
